series.title: Data Engineering for Cheminformatics
series.tagline: From SDF files and spreadsheets to a clean, searchable chemical database.
series.level: For chemists who know some Python
series.summary: Six modules that take a compound library from loose files to a checked, queryable database: structures stored as molecules in PostgreSQL, cleaned and standardised, enriched from ChEMBL and PubChem, validated before use, and ready for machine learning.

modules.title: From SDF files to a chemical database
modules.what: Load a compound library into PostgreSQL with the RDKit cartridge, store structures as molecules, and search them by substructure and similarity in SQL.

modules.title: Cleaning and standardising molecules
modules.what: Strip salts, neutralise charges and choose one tautomer, so the same compound is always stored the same way.

modules.title: Pulling data from ChEMBL and PubChem
modules.what: Fetch structures and bioactivity data through their web APIs, page by page and within their rate limits, and keep them as Parquet files.

modules.title: Checking data before it is used
modules.what: Write data contracts for chemical tables (valid structures, sensible molecular weights, consistent units) and set failing rows aside for review.

modules.title: Fingerprints and descriptors at scale
modules.what: Compute Morgan fingerprints and descriptors for large libraries in parallel, and store them for fast similarity searches.

modules.title: Capstone: a screening-library pipeline
modules.what: Take a raw vendor library through cleaning, PAINS filtering and checks into machine-learning-ready tables in PostgreSQL, end to end.

series.title: The Modern Data Stack for Chemistry
series.tagline: Production tools for lab data: ingestion, warehousing, transformation and scheduling.
series.summary: The tools data teams use in industry, applied to chemistry: declarative ingestion, a fast local warehouse, version-controlled transformations with lineage, scheduled pipelines and dashboards for medicinal chemists.

modules.title: Designing a lab data architecture
modules.what: From folders and spreadsheets to a modular open-source stack.

modules.title: Declarative ingestion
modules.what: Load chemical APIs and lab exports incrementally, coping with changing schemas.

modules.title: A fast analytical warehouse
modules.what: Query millions of descriptors locally with DuckDB and Parquet.

modules.title: Transformations with lineage
modules.what: Version-controlled models joining structures with assay results.

modules.title: Scheduled pipelines
modules.what: Run standardisation and fingerprint updates automatically when new data arrives.

modules.title: Structure-activity dashboards
modules.what: Interactive views of structure-activity relationships for medicinal chemists.

series.title: Data Pipelines for Digital and Autonomous Chemistry
series.tagline: The data side of automated synthesis: from designed molecules to checked results.
series.summary: What it takes to move data safely between molecular design, robotic synthesis and analysis: checks before synthesis, reaction metadata, instrument data, pipeline monitoring and a small intake service.

modules.title: From design to make
modules.what: Why moving from a virtual library to robotic synthesis is a data problem.

modules.title: Checking molecules before synthesis
modules.what: An intake check for stereocentres, salts and unstable groups.

modules.title: Reaction and synthesis metadata
modules.what: Relational tables for conditions, building blocks, yields and purity.

modules.title: Instrument data back into the pipeline
modules.what: Parse LC-MS and NMR exports into structured tables to confirm what was made.

modules.title: Monitoring lab data pipelines
modules.what: Catch schema drift, missing readings and corrupted values before they reach a model.

modules.title: A chemical intake service
modules.what: Wrap the checks and structure previews in a small web API.

modules.title: Capstone: a closed-loop pipeline
modules.what: Validate targets, log metadata, check analytical results and update the dataset safely.
